messages:
Emily Chen: Quick sync — handing off the Lighthouse pilot (AcmeHealth). Need a short, final checklist for batching/caching/quant decisions before we go GA. Who's got time for a 15-min slot?
Jason Patel: I can do 15:30 PT today. main questions: default batch size, KV cache TTL, and which quant profile to ship.
María Gómez: +1. Also need acceptance criteria from the field team — what do they need to validate on their side?
Ankit Rao: For batching: suggest adaptive batching with max_batch=64, p99 latency guard at 300ms. If p99 > 300ms, fall back to max_batch=8.
Liu Wei: For KV cache TTL the pilot workload has many repeated prefixes -> set default TTL=30m and allow per-route override. We'll collect hit-rate telemetry and adjust.
Samir K: Quantization — we should ship INT8-fast for low-cost lane and keep FP16 fallback. Need a compatibility test for hallucination delta.
Emily Chen: Sounds good. We need concrete launch gates. Draft proposal:
- Gate A (pilot go): deploy to AcmeHealth with adaptive batching, TTL=30m, INT8-fast enabled but route to FP16 if quality drops >2% on eval set.
- Gate B (GA): 2 weeks stable, average token cost down 22%, no increase in critical error rate, SLOs met.
Jason Patel: Can we make the quality rollback automatic? If eval alert triggers, route to FP16 automatically for that tenant.
María Gómez: Yes — implement eval-triggered alert that creates a per-tenant policy: fallback_model=FP16. Should be reversible.
Ankit Rao: Proposed rollout logic in code:
```
if eval_alert_delta > 2%:
  set_route(tenant, model='fp16')
  notify(#product, @EMILY)
else:
  continue
```
(very rough)
Liu Wei: Telemetry we need from ops: batch size distribution, p50/p95/p99 latency, KV hit rate, token cost delta, eval-concordance metric. Make sure these are in the console dashboard.
Emily Chen: Acceptance metrics to give to AcmeHealth for the pilot:
- latency p99 <= 350ms (end-to-end)
- token cost reduction >= 20% vs baseline
- eval concordance drop <= 2%
- KV hit rate >= 15% within first week
(If any fail, automatic rollback to previous model version and notify)
Samir K: What's the plan for customer ask about on-prem quant? They want determinism. INT8-fast is non-deterministic across GPU drivers. Maybe offer INT8-deterministic (slower) as option.
Emily Chen: Good point — add as an opt-in toggle for Dedicated/Private tenants: quant_profile=INT8-deterministic. Document perf tradeoffs.
Dena (deploy-bot): Deploy scheduled: canary to 5% tenants at 03:00 UTC, 12h ramp if no regressions, otherwise rollback.
Jason Patel: For the canary, include a small eval set run after first 30m and at 6h. If eval delta >1.5% at 30m, abort.
María Gómez: Also require runbook: who to ping (on-call + product lead). Add checklist item: confirm KMS keys and audit-log retention for AcmeHealth private data paths.
Emily Chen: Action items from this thread: 1) Jason + Ankit implement automatic fallback logic and canary eval hooks. 2) Liu add dashboard panels for the telemetry points. 3) Samir add INT8-deterministic option doc and perf numbers. 4) María prepare pilot acceptance doc for AcmeHealth. 5) I'll schedule the 15-min sync at 15:30 PT.
Ankit Rao: I'll kick off PR for routing policy now.
Jason Patel: Adding canary job to CI, will post PR link here.
Emily Chen: Thanks all — keeping this short. We'll confirm wording in the 15:30 sync. :thumbsup:
